# Move-down rule vs. fixed stake (generated by src/move_down.py)

Rule: at least 50 buy-ins per stake, move down one stake below 30 buy-ins, move back up at 50 buy-ins of the stake above (never above the starting stake). 1 buy-in = 100 bb. Stake ladder ratio 2, two stakes below the starting one. 'Ruin' under the rule = below 30 buy-ins of the lowest stake.

4,000 simulated careers of 500,000 hands each; both rules use the same random draws.

| SD (bb/100) | True win rate (bb/100) | Fixed stake: lose all 50 buy-ins | Move-down rule: ruin | Careers that ever moved down | Median share of hands below the starting stake |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 70 | 4.00 | 0.0% | 0.00% | 4% | 0% |
| 70 | 2.06 | 1.3% | 0.05% | 17% | 0% |
| 100 | 4.00 | 1.5% | 0.18% | 19% | 0% |
| 100 | 1.23 | 21.2% | 10.30% | 56% | 13% |
| 130 | 4.00 | 8.7% | 2.88% | 37% | 0% |
| 130 | 0.40 | 51.0% | 41.10% | 78% | 26% |
